library(stats)

# User-specified parameters
mean_reduction <- 3  # kg (effect size: true difference)
sd_baseline <- 5     # kg
sd_followup <- 5.5   # kg
rho <- 0.5           # within-person correlation
alpha <- 0.05        # Type I error
target_power <- 0.80 # 80%
sided <- 1           # one-sided

# Compute the variance of the difference score
# Var(diff) = Var(baseline) + Var(followup) - 2*ρ*SD_baseline*SD_followup
var_diff <- sd_baseline^2 + sd_followup^2 - 2 * rho * sd_baseline * sd_followup
sd_diff <- sqrt(var_diff)

cat("=== Paired t-test Sample Size Calculation ===\n")
cat("Effect parameters:\n")
cat("  Mean weight reduction (δ):", mean_reduction, "kg\n")
cat("  Baseline SD (σ_baseline):", sd_baseline, "kg\n")
cat("  Follow-up SD (σ_followup):", sd_followup, "kg\n")
cat("  Within-person correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("  Variance of difference: Var(diff) =", sd_baseline^2, "+", sd_followup^2, "- 2*", rho, "*", sd_baseline, "*", sd_followup, "=", var_diff, "\n")
cat("  SD of difference (σ_diff):", sd_diff, "kg\n")
cat("  Standardized effect (Cohen's d):", mean_reduction / sd_diff, "\n\n")

cat("Test parameters:\n")
cat("  Hypothesis: H0: μ_difference ≤ 0 vs H1: μ_difference > 0\n")
cat("  Sidedness:", sided, "(one-sided)\n")
cat("  Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Critical value for one-sided test (t-distribution with large df approximation)
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha)  # one-sided critical z
cat("Critical z-value (one-sided, α=0.05):", z_alpha, "\n")

# Power function for paired t-test using approximation and exact calculation
# For a given n, compute power iteratively

power_paired_ttest <- function(n, delta, sd_diff, alpha, sided = 1) {
  # delta: true mean difference
  # sd_diff: SD of the difference scores
  # alpha: Type I error
  # sided: 1 for one-sided, 2 for two-sided
  
  df <- n - 1
  noncentrality <- delta / sd_diff * sqrt(n)
  
  if (sided == 1) {
    # One-sided test: reject if t > t_crit
    t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
    power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = noncentrality)
  } else {
    # Two-sided test
    t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df)
    power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = noncentrality) + pt(-t_crit, df, ncp = noncentrality)
  }
  return(power)
}

# Find the minimum sample size satisfying power >= 0.80
n_candidate <- seq(2, 200)
powers <- sapply(n_candidate, function(n) {
  power_paired_ttest(n, mean_reduction, sd_diff, alpha, sided)
})

# Find minimum n with power >= target_power
idx_sufficient <- which(powers >= target_power)
if (length(idx_sufficient) > 0) {
  n_min <- n_candidate[idx_sufficient[1]]
  power_at_min <- powers[idx_sufficient[1]]
  
  # Also report power at n_min - 1 for reference
  if (n_min > 2) {
    n_prev <- n_min - 1
    power_at_prev <- power_paired_ttest(n_prev, mean_reduction, sd_diff, alpha, sided)
  } else {
    n_prev <- NA
    power_at_prev <- NA
  }
} else {
  cat("ERROR: No sample size found meeting the target power\n")
  n_min <- NA
  power_at_min <- NA
}

cat("\n=== Results ===\n")
cat("Minimum sample size (integer):", n_min, "participants\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", n_min, ":", round(power_at_min, 4), "\n")
if (!is.na(n_prev)) {
  cat("Achieved power at n =", n_prev, "(preceding):", round(power_at_prev, 4), "\n")
}

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
result_list <- list(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_min,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(result_list)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n", sep = "")

library(stats)

# User-specified parameters
mean_reduction <- 3  # kg (effect size: true difference)
sd_baseline <- 5     # kg
sd_followup <- 5.5   # kg
rho <- 0.5           # within-person correlation
alpha <- 0.05        # Type I error
target_power <- 0.80 # 80%
sided <- 1           # one-sided

# Compute the variance of the difference score
# Var(diff) = Var(baseline) + Var(followup) - 2*ρ*SD_baseline*SD_followup
var_diff <- sd_baseline^2 + sd_followup^2 - 2 * rho * sd_baseline * sd_followup
sd_diff <- sqrt(var_diff)

cat("=== Paired t-test Sample Size Calculation ===\n")
cat("Effect parameters:\n")
cat("  Mean weight reduction (δ):", mean_reduction, "kg\n")
cat("  Baseline SD (σ_baseline):", sd_baseline, "kg\n")
cat("  Follow-up SD (σ_followup):", sd_followup, "kg\n")
cat("  Within-person correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("  Variance of difference: Var(diff) =", sd_baseline^2, "+", sd_followup^2, "- 2*", rho, "*", sd_baseline, "*", sd_followup, "=", var_diff, "\n")
cat("  SD of difference (σ_diff):", sd_diff, "kg\n")
cat("  Standardized effect (Cohen's d):", mean_reduction / sd_diff, "\n\n")

cat("Test parameters:\n")
cat("  Hypothesis: H0: μ_difference ≤ 0 vs H1: μ_difference > 0\n")
cat("  Sidedness:", sided, "(one-sided)\n")
cat("  Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Critical value for one-sided test (t-distribution with large df approximation)
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha)  # one-sided critical z
cat("Critical z-value (one-sided, α=0.05):", z_alpha, "\n")

# Power function for paired t-test using approximation and exact calculation
# For a given n, compute power iteratively

power_paired_ttest <- function(n, delta, sd_diff, alpha, sided = 1) {
  # delta: true mean difference
  # sd_diff: SD of the difference scores
  # alpha: Type I error
  # sided: 1 for one-sided, 2 for two-sided
  
  df <- n - 1
  noncentrality <- delta / sd_diff * sqrt(n)
  
  if (sided == 1) {
    # One-sided test: reject if t > t_crit
    t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
    power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = noncentrality)
  } else {
    # Two-sided test
    t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df)
    power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = noncentrality) + pt(-t_crit, df, ncp = noncentrality)
  }
  return(power)
}

# Find the minimum sample size satisfying power >= 0.80

powers <- sapply(n_candidate, function(n) {
  power_paired_ttest(n, mean_reduction, sd_diff, alpha, sided)
})

  }

}

  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_min,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

# Evidence e1; success=true

library(stats)

# User-specified parameters
mean_reduction <- 3  # kg (effect size: true difference)
sd_baseline <- 5     # kg
sd_followup <- 5.5   # kg
rho <- 0.5           # within-person correlation
alpha <- 0.05        # Type I error
target_power <- 0.80 # 80%
sided <- 1           # one-sided

# Compute the variance of the difference score
# Var(diff) = Var(baseline) + Var(followup) - 2*ρ*SD_baseline*SD_followup
var_diff <- sd_baseline^2 + sd_followup^2 - 2 * rho * sd_baseline * sd_followup
sd_diff <- sqrt(var_diff)

cat("=== Paired t-test Sample Size Calculation ===\n")
cat("Effect parameters:\n")
cat("  Mean weight reduction (δ):", mean_reduction, "kg\n")
cat("  Baseline SD (σ_baseline):", sd_baseline, "kg\n")
cat("  Follow-up SD (σ_followup):", sd_followup, "kg\n")
cat("  Within-person correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("  Variance of difference: Var(diff) =", sd_baseline^2, "+", sd_followup^2, "- 2*", rho, "*", sd_baseline, "*", sd_followup, "=", var_diff, "\n")
cat("  SD of difference (σ_diff):", sd_diff, "kg\n")
cat("  Standardized effect (Cohen's d):", mean_reduction / sd_diff, "\n\n")

cat("Test parameters:\n")
cat("  Hypothesis: H0: μ_difference ≤ 0 vs H1: μ_difference > 0\n")
cat("  Sidedness:", sided, "(one-sided)\n")
cat("  Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Critical value for one-sided test (t-distribution with large df approximation)
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha)  # one-sided critical z
cat("Critical z-value (one-sided, α=0.05):", z_alpha, "\n")

# Power function for paired t-test using approximation and exact calculation
# For a given n, compute power iteratively

power_paired_ttest <- function(n, delta, sd_diff, alpha, sided = 1) {
  # delta: true mean difference
  # sd_diff: SD of the difference scores
  # alpha: Type I error
  # sided: 1 for one-sided, 2 for two-sided
  
  df <- n - 1
  noncentrality <- delta / sd_diff * sqrt(n)
  
  if (sided == 1) {
    # One-sided test: reject if t > t_crit
    t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
    power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = noncentrality)
  } else {
    # Two-sided test
    t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df)
    power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = noncentrality) + pt(-t_crit, df, ncp = noncentrality)
  }
  return(power)
}

# Find the minimum sample size satisfying power >= 0.80
n_candidate <- seq(2, 200)
powers <- sapply(n_candidate, function(n) {
  power_paired_ttest(n, mean_reduction, sd_diff, alpha, sided)
})

# Find minimum n with power >= target_power
idx_sufficient <- which(powers >= target_power)
if (length(idx_sufficient) > 0) {
  n_min <- n_candidate[idx_sufficient[1]]
  power_at_min <- powers[idx_sufficient[1]]
  
  # Also report power at n_min - 1 for reference
  if (n_min > 2) {
    n_prev <- n_min - 1
    power_at_prev <- power_paired_ttest(n_prev, mean_reduction, sd_diff, alpha, sided)
  } else {
    n_prev <- NA
    power_at_prev <- NA
  }
} else {
  cat("ERROR: No sample size found meeting the target power\n")
  n_min <- NA
  power_at_min <- NA
}

cat("\n=== Results ===\n")
cat("Minimum sample size (integer):", n_min, "participants\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", n_min, ":", round(power_at_min, 4), "\n")
if (!is.na(n_prev)) {
  cat("Achieved power at n =", n_prev, "(preceding):", round(power_at_prev, 4), "\n")
}

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
result_list <- list(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_min,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(result_list)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n", sep = "")
